title: Devil May Cry 3: Dante's Awakening arrives on PlayStation 2
summary: In 2005, Devil May Cry 3: Dante's Awakening became a notable game release milestone in PlayStation 2 history.

blocks.text: In 2005, Devil May Cry 3: Dante's Awakening became a notable game release milestone in PlayStation 2 history.
In the action and adventure category, Devil May Cry 3: Dante's Awakening broadened the PlayStation 2 library and reflects the range of experiences available during the console's long commercial life.
